brief:
Britain's reopened refugee resettlement program excludes Palestinians in Gaza, preventing families separated by the conflict from reuniting, Al Jazeera English reported. The scheme, which aims to resettle vulnerable refugees, does not cover Palestinians currently in the territory, leaving families unable to access what officials describe as a lifeline for those in danger.

Officials warn that the exclusion carries urgent humanitarian consequences. "Every day could cost lives," one source told the outlet, highlighting the dangers faced by Palestinians remaining in Gaza amid ongoing conditions there.
dek: Britain’s reopened refugee resettlement scheme offers no escape for Palestinians in Gaza.
title: UK blocks Gaza Palestinians from family reunion scheme
